nodes.label: THREEBODY-DELIVERY-1
nodes.rationale: Delivered in answer to the REQUEST — THE METHOD 1.6 BUILD, with the baseline bundle's md5 confirmed identical to the build's original before any object is reported.

nodes.label: Nothing from the three-body session survives as a file
nodes.rationale: The container was never sealed and the outputs folder never uploaded, so only the PDF in Prints & Proofs survives; severity FOUNDATIONAL for five of the ten objects.

nodes.label: Labelled reconstruction, not file-as-produced
nodes.rationale: Every instrument was recovered line-by-line from the transcript and re-run, so it carries no md5 of an original; the test of faithfulness is that every printed figure in the record reproduces exactly.

nodes.label: 3B.tri is an Index-of-Indices object label, never a file
nodes.rationale: Treating a label as a filename would make an absent file out of an object that was never one; the closure is a function in audit.py using the project's own min/max operator, not the book's tower-2.py.

nodes.label: N8: the withdrawn polynomial kept with its coefficients as first written
nodes.rationale: Both states are preserved so the two wrong terms can be isolated rather than quietly replaced.

nodes.label: Routh threshold: cited, never computed, now verified
nodes.rationale: The session cited mu < 0.0385209 without computing it; routh_check.py verifies it as (9-sqrt(69))/18, moving the claim from CITED to COMPUTED.

nodes.label: Mass-uniformity: masses enter as six numbers only
nodes.rationale: Read off the code rather than asserted: closure_test and P8 take no mass argument and the metric is not coded, so the combinatorial objects are mass-free.

nodes.label: Stratification as index — not held, never data
nodes.rationale: E(F)=0 was a theorem-assembly, not a computation; no data object was ever built, so the book should label these record-carried rather than reporting a lost file.
